KayMaze asset sources

Pokemon portraits and fallback animations:
https://github.com/PokeAPI/sprites
Generation V Black/White front sprites. Character art belongs to Nintendo,
Game Freak and The Pokemon Company.

Species names, current types, base stats and move learnsets:
https://github.com/PokeAPI/pokeapi/tree/master/data/v2/csv
Species-specific moves are based on Ultra Sun / Ultra Moon learnsets,
including moves retained from a pre-evolution. Obstacle damage and effects
are game-specific adaptations rather than main-series battle rules.

Directional battle sprites and centered head portraits:
https://github.com/PMDCollab/SpriteCollab
See assets/directional/CREDITS.txt, LICENSE.md, credit_names.txt and the
per-species histories in assets/directional.

Included for this unofficial noncommercial fan game.
